reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed acute isogenic p53 depletion and near-endogenous rescue, separate caffeine perturbation, longitudinal and fixed cell-cycle/death measurements.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing p53-Necessity and Rescue-Specificity for Damage-Induced G1 Arrest
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols to select conditions and check transfer to this system.

checks.quote: clone-specific artifact, not p53 effect
checks.reason: Clone discordance does not establish artifact: real clone-dependent p53 biology is also possible. Investigate rather than assert this exclusive explanation.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing p53-Necessity and Rescue-Specificity for Damage-Induced G1 Arrest
checks.reason: No parental authentication, contamination or passage-integrity qualification despite genetic architecture and functional pilots.

checks.quote: Parameters marked "calibrate"
checks.reason: Actual engineering/delivery and assay preparation quantities, pulse/staining conditions and an executable calibration-to-selection procedure are missing.

checks.quote: fraction of *live* cells
checks.reason: The primary endpoint conditions on survival. Equal aggregate death does not remove phase-selective loss; the original G1 cohort denominator and explicit unknown-fate bounds are needed, rather than a survivor-only sensitivity analysis.

checks.quote: exclusion of cells leaving the field or touching edges
checks.reason: Post-treatment loss/short tracks are excluded without retaining their original-cohort contribution or an outcome-independent attrition rule. Migration/trackability can depend on treatment.

checks.quote: multiplicity correction limited
checks.reason: No actual correction or gatekeeping procedure is specified for the necessity/rescue contrast family. Stating its scope is not specifying the procedure.

checks.quote: construct a dose series
checks.reason: Dose, exposure and caffeine exploration have no defined bounds or rule deriving bounds/stopping the search before lock.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing p53-Necessity and Rescue-Specificity for Damage-Induced G1 Arrest
checks.reason: Technical retuning is described, but no explicit refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after changed doses, clones or timing.

checks.quote: recovery fraction
checks.reason: Positive intact-minus-depleted arrest establishes contribution, not necessity if a substantial residual response remains. A recovery fraction of at least 0.7 with CI excluding zero also does not establish equivalence to intact response.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing p53-Necessity and Rescue-Specificity for Damage-Induced G1 Arrest
checks.reason: No linked raw images/flow files, cell-well histories and exact code/environment/gating/model settings for audit.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing p53-Necessity and Rescue-Specificity for Damage-Induced G1 Arrest
checks.reason: Explicit proposed design with functional dynamic rescue, tag-free degrader control, empty/mutant rescue and separate caffeine. No-EdU, positive death and compensation/reference controls support assay calibration; pilot-powered independent cultures, clones and blinded blocks are appropriate. The later physical-lesion check corrects reliance on signaling-marker kinetics. Live phase and fixed incorporation are complementary. Survivor selection and necessity/restoration rules remain non-identifying; these are charged under the specific endpoint/decision checks, not again under G3.
